depiction.composition: single framed icon with corner modifier badge

readings.meaning: add photo / upload image / insert picture

ambiguity: Very similar to plain image/photo icons at small sizes if the plus sign blends into the frame corner.

reasoning: A standard picture frame with mountains combined with a corner plus badge universally means 'add/upload photo or image'. It fits many common tasks across personal, administrative, shopping, and work domains (uploading photos to listings, albums, claims, or docs), though it is only slightly differentiated from a plain image icon.
